method: Each definition in s9-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations, as envoi_web; merchant accounts are created by the operator functions with passwords generated in memory per run, and their FIXTURE shops are created through the merchant routes. Every SGQR payload is a FIXTURE built tag by tag; none is an authentic sticker. A migration mutation takes effect because each test file migrates a fresh disposable database. A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.

results.test: unrecognized tags are surfaced not guessed
results.mutation: Drop every tag the decoder does not recognize instead of listing it; the test fails.

results.test: raw QR payload is not logged
results.mutation: Remove the QR payload redaction from the logger; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: logs: expected true to be false // Object.is equality

results.test: personal proxy is not published as a business identifier
results.mutation: Allow a proxy mapping: a personal PayNow proxy becomes a mappable identifier; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 200 to be 400 // Object.is equality

results.test: the database refuses a mapping that is not a business UEN
results.mutation: Let the scheme check admit paynow_proxy; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 'inserted' to be '23514 outlet_identifiers_scheme_check' // Object.is equality

results.test: checksum validity is computed, not assumed
results.mutation: Report every checksum as valid; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality

results.test: a payload that is not EMVCo decodes to nothing
results.mutation: Keep the tags parsed before a length overrun instead of refusing the payload; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: "00020101021126370009SG.PAYNOW010120210T2": expected { kind: 'decoded', …(3) } to deeply equal { kind: 'not_emvco' }

results.test: a PayNow mobile number decodes as a proxy, not a UEN
results.mutation: Read every PayNow proxy as a UEN, ignoring its proxy type; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected [ { scheme: 'paynow_uen', …(2) } ] to deeply equal [ { scheme: 'paynow_proxy', …(2) } ]

results.mutation: Skip the UEN format check; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: S1234567D: expected { scheme: 'paynow_uen', …(1) } to match object { reason: 'uen_format' }

results.test: a sticker submission records the server's decode, not the browser's
results.mutation: Record every submitted sticker's checksum as valid instead of the server's decode; the test fails.

results.test: a sticker submission records the server's decode, not the browser's
results.mutation: Record every sticker submission as taken from the sticker, even a corrected UEN; the test fails.

results.test: a repeated identifier is not submitted twice
results.mutation: Make the outlet, scheme and identifier index non-unique; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 200 to be 400 // Object.is equality

results.test: a shop submits at most five identifiers
results.mutation: Remove the five-identifier limit; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected undefined to match object { code: 'validation_failed', …(1) }

results.test: only the operator approves an identifier mapping
results.mutation: Grant the web role INSERT on every column, including approved_at; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 'inserted' to be '42501' // Object.is equality

results.test: only the operator approves an identifier mapping
results.mutation: Grant the web role UPDATE on the table; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 'updated' to be '42501' // Object.is equality

results.test: a body mixing shop details and an identifier is refused whole
results.mutation: Let the identifier body ignore unknown keys, so shop details beside an identifier are dropped silently; the test fails.
results.error: AssertionError: expected 200 to be 400 // Object.is equality
